title: The user likes it, but the tests fail
description: A polished parser refactor is accepted on first inspection, while two independent fixtures still fail.
learning_goal: Human acceptance and objective task outcome can move in opposite directions.

human_acceptance.evidence: The user said the result looked good.

title: The verifier is stale
description: A long-running audit detects that the source snapshot changed after the verifier was configured.
learning_goal: Stop the affected action, recover verification, and avoid disturbing the human while bounded recovery remains.

objective_outcome.criterion: The audit and verifier use the same immutable source snapshot.
objective_outcome.evidence: The current source hash differs from the checkpoint hash.

human_acceptance.criterion: The user accepts the completed audit.
human_acceptance.evidence: No completed audit has been presented.

title: The system can make options; the user owns the taste
description: A visual treatment passes accessibility and format checks, but several equally safe aesthetic directions remain.
learning_goal: Generate low-consequence options autonomously and interrupt only when the final taste decision is ready.

objective_outcome.criterion: Every option meets accessibility and format requirements.
objective_outcome.evidence: Automated checks pass for the current option set.

human_acceptance.criterion: The user prefers the final visual direction.
human_acceptance.evidence: The final options have not yet been curated.

title: A consequential release with conflicting evidence
description: A policy brief could affect real people, and the evidence supports two materially different interpretations.
learning_goal: High consequence plus unresolved ambiguity creates a human authority floor.

objective_outcome.criterion: The published claim is accurate and does not create material harm.
objective_outcome.evidence: Two credible sources support conflicting interpretations.

human_acceptance.criterion: The accountable owner accepts the release.
human_acceptance.evidence: No release decision has been made.

title: A verified, reversible maintenance fix
description: The system has repaired a local configuration, all independent checks pass, and rollback is available.
learning_goal: Low-consequence work can remain autonomous when capability, reversibility, and verification align.

objective_outcome.criterion: The configuration loads and the regression suite passes.
objective_outcome.evidence: The frozen regression suite passes and a rollback patch exists.

human_acceptance.criterion: The user accepts the maintenance outcome.
human_acceptance.evidence: The user has not been interrupted for routine implementation detail.
